data.long_meaning: Biswajit means 'the lord of all knowledge'. It is derived from two Sanskrit words: 'Biswa' meaning 'all' and 'Jit' meaning 'conqueror'. According to Hindu mythology, Biswajit is the name of a god who imparts wisdom and knowledge to his devotees. The name Biswajeet carries the meaning “Lord of all knowledge” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Biswajeet usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of all knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
